snippet.title: Execute Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the Execute Steam Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3829620/Execute/

The trailer for my upcoming game Execute. A dark incremental game about destroying the world. Inspired by Destroy All Humans, and Plague Inc. it lets you play the villain and automate the destruction of the human race through addictive gameplay loops.
